Anorith

Rock Bug

Hoenn · Generation 3

Anorith is a Rock/Bug-type Old Shrimp Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 12.5 kg. It evolves into Armaldo. Its highest base stat is Attack (95), with a base stat total of 355.
